items.title: Ray Shiner interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, October 11, 1998
items.q: I says, “Joey, I’m retiring.” He says, “Come to Syracuse, I’ll get you a band.”

ctx.x: Well that’s a compliment. © Fillius Jazz Archive -18-
I says, “Joey, I’m retiring.” He says, “Come to Syracuse, I’ll get you a band.” He knew that was the first thing in my life.
